title: Introduce RBACv2 temporal boundaries and KMS audit hasher
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds RBACv2 timebound grants, KMS audit hashing middleware, and policy compiler temporal checks. Operators must upgrade operator-tooling; see docs/ops/rbacv2-timebound.md for migration steps.
description: Context: Customers operating under strict residency and audit constraints asked for short-lived operator grants and for KMS usage telemetry that reduces exposure of raw key identifiers. This change implements RBACv2 temporal grant semantics (start_time, expiry, max-lifetime) at the policy layer, a deterministic KMS audit hasher that salts and hashes key identifiers before emitting to metrics and long-term logs, and a compiler pass to validate temporal constraints at policy resolution time. Included is a migration helper that maps legacy service grants to expiring equivalents requiring explicit operator consent for lifetime extensions. Checklist: design doc ENG-6128 linked, unit tests added, integration test harness updated, ops docs added at docs/ops/rbacv2-timebound.md, security review completed. Rollout plan: staged canary (1% -> 10% -> 100%) with a feature flag to disable temporal enforcement per region. Impact: no public API contract changes for normal RBAC lookups, operator CLI & dashboard changes required; see release_notes for steps.
